status_semantics: ready/planned are planning states, not accepted completion; use source-pinned result receipts

tasks.title: Freeze integration contracts and reconcile the merged baseline
steps: Read b986382 and subsequent main changes; inventory each original E23 requirement using the crosswalk. Keep existing implemented features; record divergence from old contracts (JSON config, uppercase secret filenames, opaque sessions, actual packages).

With chief-architect, resolve and publish the four bounded design decisions in interfaces.md: physical storage reservation/headroom, crash-safe canonical-operation accounting, independently durable deletion journal, and restore eligibility. Required invariants and preferred mechanisms are in the execution plan. No worker chooses a weaker substitute. The journal design must prove completeness through activation and fence old service writers; a sequence/checksum alone does not prove no tail was omitted.

Freeze callable Go interfaces and failure codes for ReconcileCustomer, CloseBillingAccount, operation outcome reconciliation, deletion journal AppendDeletion/ReadThrough/Seal, backup manifest v2, restore Plan/Apply and telemetry. Specify lock order, request cancellation, accounting units and every new config field. Freeze a deterministic fault-barrier API compiled only under the hostedtest build tag, using inherited private pipes/files, never an HTTP endpoint or production environment switch. Feature owners implement checkpoints in their files before qualification begins.

As the sole schema owner, add forward-only migrations and helper APIs needed by tasks44/47/48/50 in reviewed increments before those dependent workers start. Migration must preserve schema1–3 data; never edit an applied migration. Do not add no-op production methods just to make interfaces compile. All applied SQL remains single-writer; reserve each migration version and its owning feature in interfaces.md. Feature workers submit schema/API requests and wait for the integrator commit instead of editing store files.

Publish a source-pinned interface receipt. Coordinator applies all subsequent shared-file requests and integrates each feature immediately in dependency order; task57 is the final integration/release gate, not permission to leave feature code unconnected.
acceptance: Architectural review names the exact revision and approves each of the four decisions; unresolved decision means dependent task is blocked, not an agent guess.
Migrate schema1/2/3 fixture DBs twice; facts, subscriptions, tokens and usage retained; future schema refused without writes; fresh DB and upgraded DB equivalent.
Existing hosted tests and file-first gate pass. Interface document lists owning task, exact signature, semantic contract, schema version and integration file for every shared seam.

tasks.title: Qualify the OpenRouter-compatible adapter and fail closed on invalid vectors
steps: Use https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 and candidate perplexity/pplx-embed-v1-0.6b; EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY remains the provider-neutral secret filename. Do not change the production pin merely because a model is listed.

Confirm current primary documentation for endpoint, JSON numeric-vector encoding, model identity, dimension, input limit, cosine requirement, pricing, routing, retention and training use. Explicitly distinguish Perplexity direct terms from the serving provider selected by OpenRouter.

Test numeric INT8 values decoded into existing float storage; reject empty, nonfinite, malformed or inconsistent-dimension vectors. Persist/check a stable model+version+dimension pin; a mismatch must not silently mix spaces. Handle 401/429/5xx, deadlines, cancellation and absent usage.

Return sanitized typed provider errors; never return upstream body text that may echo input or a credential. Freeze provider routing to a privacy-qualified provider where supported; if the API cannot enforce required terms, fail qualification.

Provide integrator config/wiring request. Keep readiness probes bounded and account for their cost. Fix provider usage/cost recording only with explicit units; no silent cl100k_base=provider-token assumption. No paid fallback or background retries that bypass the configured budget.
acceptance: Fixture server asserts endpoint, model, auth placement, cancellation and request body; error fixtures cannot leak sentinels in response/logs.
Pin/dimension mismatch cannot corrupt or silently reuse old index; compatibility verified with numeric INT8 and float fixtures.
Provider contract reports privacy status as verified/blocked with citations and date; fixture pass is not live qualification.

tasks.title: Build a reproducible semantic retrieval qualification corpus
steps: Create100 synthetic query cases:40 paraphrases,20 names/entities,20 preferences/negation/near-duplicates,10 multilingual positive cases,5 temporal positive cases and5 expected-empty forgotten/expired cases. All95 positive cases have exactly one expected factID and scored distractors. No customer data. At least20 paraphrases lack useful content-word overlap.

Create a CLI harness that targets the real hosted MCP endpoint and separately runs lexical-only control in a disposable brain; never add a public debug bypass. Record model pin, provider, dimensions, corpus hash, exact source SHA, usage and elapsed time.

Support --fixtures for harness verification and explicit --live with a manifest budget/token/call cap, no automatic alternative-model routing. Query vectors and stored vectors use cosine semantics; test vector scale invariance.
Freeze expected IDs and candidate quality thresholds before looking at live outcomes. Save per-query ranks and failures; never adjust corpus/threshold to turn red green.
acceptance: Before live evaluation, task41 reviewer freezes: Hit@5 (one relevant fact/query) >=0.90 over95 positive queries; paraphrases>=36/40; names>=19/20; preferences>=19/20; multilingual>=9/10; temporal=5/5. At least18/20 lexical-negative paraphrases hit semantically and miss in the lexical control. All5 expected-empty cases return no current fact; all cross-account/forgotten leakage=0. Expected-empty queries are excluded from Hit@5 denominator and scored separately.
Fixed-vector or lexical-only stub fails the quality predicate; fixture mode can pass harness mechanics but never marks quality PASS.
Budget exhausted/provider unavailable yields BLOCKED with partial results and no further calls. Threshold changes need a separate reviewed rationale, not a worker override.

tasks.title: Make quota accounting recoverable and storage admission bounded
steps: Implement the task41 operation ledger keyed by account+brain+canonical operation_key. Reserve writes and input units atomically; persist canonical outcome and finalize both counters atomically. Reconcile interrupted operations from canonical truth before expiring/releasing leases. For calls without operation_key, allocate and persist a distinct internal operation ID before mutation and carry it into canonical outcome evidence; only repeated explicit client keys deduplicate independent requests.

Treat failure after canonical commit as an unknown/durable outcome, never as an ordinary failed write that releases quota. Retries across brains/windows preserve one canonical fact and one committed charge; failed audit insertion cannot erase accounting.

Enforce the reviewed physical-byte admission/headroom contract before mutation, including Git history, canonical bytes, index/vector/WAL growth and concurrent brains. Never delete an acknowledged fact to recover space. If a safe upper bound cannot be established, block writes and escalate the contract; do not silently redefine published storage.

Keep export, deletion, billing cancellation and idempotent replay available at quota exhaustion. Test period rollover, released-row cleanup and all six published allowances. Produce a shared seam request for any core writer/index change; gate allowlist stays unchanged.
Implement the task41 hostedtest-only phase barriers in owned code and a test proving production builds cannot activate them; include phase names in the integration receipt for task58.
acceptance: 100 concurrent one-write requests with allowance60 admit exactly60; one-byte headroom cannot produce an acknowledged write above the defined ceiling.

Crash after canonical write/flush/audit/token-finalization boundaries then retry consumes exactly one write and the agreed input units. A genuinely failed mutation consumes none. Cover unkeyed writes and identical content submitted with distinct keys.
Concurrent account brains share caps; forgotten Git history still counts; replay at zero remaining is safe; auth/readiness checks leave customer usage unchanged.

tasks.title: Remove avoidable tenant blocking and qualify fair admission
steps: Move cold runtime open/recovery outside the global pool lock with bounded per-brain opening coordination; preserve exactly one writer/runtime and total open/in-flight caps. Do not hold gateway global map lock over provider or disk work.

Make queued account admission context-aware and bounded before tool timeout starts; define per-account/per-brain/global semantics explicitly. Hash collisions must not cause unbounded unrelated-tenant waits.

Apply equivalent account admission to dashboard memory actions and authenticated MCP, without denying recovery/export/delete solely because write quota is exhausted. Bound maintenance/export work separately.

Exercise churn of credentials, MCP sessions, limiter keys and cold brains; expired/revoked entries relinquish capacity. Honor only trusted loopback proxy headers. Keep Scale ten-brain connectivity possible.
acceptance: Over-cap admission returns typed capacity within100ms in deterministic local tests; canceled queued requests do no work and release permits.
Hot tenant with a blocked provider does not prevent an independent warm tenant from serving within its timeout; cold-open burst remains bounded.
Authenticated account/IP 429 includes Retry-After; multiple credentials cannot multiply quotas/concurrency; spoofed client-IP cannot bypass controls; maps plateau under sustained churn.

tasks.title: Complete identity edge cases and optional pilot admission
steps: Keep Resend magic-link/opaque-session architecture. Test single-use concurrency, expiration, replay, login throttling, capacity and interrupted provisioning with deterministic clocks.

Add the task41 registration-mode contract: public mode preserves current approved scope; invitation-only mode is deny-by-default for uninvited new email identities, with an operator-managed private allowlist. Existing eligible accounts can sign in; never log allowlist contents.
Optional pilot admission is implemented/tested but not activated by this plan. It must gate the actual signup/account-creation path, not only hide the website CTA.

Ensure deleting/restore_pending accounts cannot regain normal access; only the existing deletion retry route gets restricted session access. Re-signup after completed deletion creates a new identity/brain and cannot reconnect old tokens.
Implement the task41 hostedtest-only phase barriers in owned code and a test proving production builds cannot activate them; include phase names in the integration receipt for task58.
acceptance: Forged/expired/reused magic links and sessions denied; cookie renewal matches server expiry; logout invalidates server-side state.
Uninvited direct login submission creates neither account nor brain in pilot mode; allowed signup occurs exactly once under concurrency.
Crash-recovery fixture does not create duplicate default/additional brains; account-cap arithmetic remains atomic.

tasks.title: Complete billing reconciliation and deletion-safe provider closure
steps: Extract the frozen ReconcileCustomer(ctx,accountID) API used by webhooks and restore. Fetch provider truth for the server-owned customer and atomically update entitlements; reject unknown prices/customer mismatch without granting paid access. Reconciliation must support restore_pending rows without activation and replace stale subscriptions/checkout attempts after authoritative resolution.

Implement CloseBillingAccount for a durable deleting account: stop new checkout, expire pending sessions, list/cancel provider subscriptions even if the creation webhook never arrived, recheck until closure is known. Resume after ambiguous provider success and local timeout.

Reconcile checkout attempts older than23h without blindly creating a duplicate. Make the repair auditable and account-scoped. Late cancellation/deletion webhooks must be acknowledged/idempotent rather than permanently retried as503.

Use authoritative subscription/invoice timestamps for the fixed72h payment-failure grace; late/reversed events cannot restart it. Document upgrade proration, period-end downgrade/cancellation and billing-portal settings.

Expand fixture state table: initial incomplete/failure, activation, renewal, upgrade, scheduled downgrade, cancellation/re-subscription, duplicate subscription, stale/duplicate/reversed events, unknown price, provider outage and provider-success/local-save failure.
Implement the task41 hostedtest-only phase barriers in owned code and a test proving production builds cannot activate them; include phase names in the integration receipt for task58.
acceptance: Checkout return alone never grants access; one customer cannot acquire duplicate active paid subscriptions through retries.
Checkout completed before webhook then deletion cancels that subscription; open checkout cannot leave a live subscription after deletion closure is certified.

Grace deadline is stable under delayed/replayed events, first observed past_due, missed activation, new invoice/renewal and delayed old failure after payment. Renewal opens a fresh allowance while retaining old-window accounting history.

tasks.title: Make deletion crash-safe with an independent durable tombstone journal
steps: Enter durable deleting state before provider work; block checkout and normal memory/session access. Use task47 provider closure before final irreversible data purge.

Use AppendDeletion to append an integrity-checked, monotonically ordered deletion intent to the task41 independent journal before acknowledging deletion. Journal contains opaque IDs/timestamps/state only, no memory/email/token. Local SQLite alone is not an independent recovery source. Journal individual-brain and account deletion, never reuse a deleted opaque ID. This task owns the runtime production object-storage journal adapter and its fixture tests, not task52.

Order and resume billing closure, credential revocation, brain directory cleanup, session/token deletion and account anonymization. Journal append failure leaves deletion pending and restricted retry available; never acknowledge a durability guarantee not achieved.

Coordinate journal storage/IAM with task52 and infra integrator; use an explicit filesystem fake locally and stack-scoped durable object storage in production. Preserve all ordinary account/brain ownership checks.
Keep export a quota-independent operation; verify canonical facts and restorable bundle. Wire dashboard via integrator request, not concurrent edits to dashboard.go.
Implement the task41 hostedtest-only phase barriers in owned code and a test proving production builds cannot activate them; include phase names in the integration receipt for task58.
acceptance: Fault injection at each phase converges to one completed deletion without resurrection, double cancellation or orphaned subscription.

Snapshot then delete, losing live disk, still leaves a valid independent deletion record; missing journal acknowledgment prevents successful delete response. Deleting one brain then restoring preserves its sibling but never the deleted brain or its credentials.
Cross-account export/delete fails without touching victim files/counters; export/deletion remain available at quota exhaustion; fresh re-signup is empty.

tasks.title: Version and verify backup manifests before restoring any bytes
steps: Implement manifestv2 with source build/schema, UTC creation, sorted unique brain inventory, bundle/control DB SHA256+length and deletion-journal watermark; preserve explicit support/refusal policy for legacyv1 snapshots.

Validate every entry, checksum, expected DB inventory, bundle integrity, duplicates, symlinks and path traversal before creating a usable destination. A ready brain missing its Git repo is corruption, not an empty-brain success.

Create snapshots only under coordinated maintenance/ownership; consistent SQLite+canonical Git captures acknowledged writes. Offline backup must verify/flush dirty canonical state or refuse rather than silently omit it.

Restore into a new private staging directory, validate fully, then atomically publish to an empty destination; failures cannot leave a runnable partial restore. Continue revoking all sessions/tokens and freezing accounts.
Implement the task41 hostedtest-only phase barriers in owned code and a test proving production builds cannot activate them; include phase names in the integration receipt for task58.
acceptance: Truncated/tampered DB/bundle/manifest, duplicate/omitted/unknown brain, unsupported schema and unsafe path all fail before reactivation.
Manifest roundtrip matches exact fact IDs and canonical bundle heads; restored raw credentials/sessions remain invalid.
Live write during coordinated backup is either included consistently or excluded as a later operation; no acknowledged pre-snapshot write lost.

tasks.title: Implement explicit restore reconciliation and safe reactivation
steps: Implement plan/apply recovery commands using task41 schema/interface and task49 manifest. Plan is read-only and emits hashed/sanitized inventory plus exact required reconciliation watermark; apply requires the unchanged plan hash.

Fetch trusted post-snapshot deletion journal through a fresh high-watermark and current Stripe truth via ReconcileCustomer. Remove deleted accounts/brains before permitting sign-in; absent/stale/integrity-failed authority leaves affected accounts frozen. Verify a complete journal through a fenced activation barrier: reject missing middle/tail, concurrent append races and a returning old writer. Merely reading the latest visible sequence is insufficient.

Keep every pre-restore credential/session revoked even for surviving accounts. Permit only fresh magic-link login and newly issued tokens after successful reconciliation. Never expose activate-all or directSQL operator shortcuts.
Persist idempotent recovery phases; interrupted plan/apply resumes. Billing-disabled pilot still requires deletion reconciliation and restores only Free eligibility, never historical paid access.
Supply CLI registration/service wiring patch request to integrator. Journal pruning cannot remove data needed by any restorable retained snapshot.
Implement the task41 hostedtest-only phase barriers in owned code and a test proving production builds cannot activate them; include phase names in the integration receipt for task58.
acceptance: Snapshot then revoke/delete/cancel, lose live state, restore: old key denied, deleted account absent, canceled plan Free, surviving facts recoverable after new login.

Provider/journal outage prevents affected activation; foreign account/modified plan hash rejected; second apply has no additional effect. Include a surviving Free account with canceled historical subscription/stale pending Checkout; no stale blocker may survive authoritative reconciliation.
Recovery report records counts, journal watermark, schema, provider mode and exact unresolved accounts without secret/customer content.

tasks.title: Bootstrap a blank ARM host idempotently and validate topology
steps: Keep AWS us-west-2 single ARM VM architecture; prepare scripts and fixtures without provisioning. Validate subnet belongs to VPC and AZ, region/account IDs and all stack inputs before preview/execution.

Install version-pinned/checksummed Caddy, Git, AWS CLI and required service dependencies on AL2023 ARM. Identify only the exact stack-owned EBS volume by ID; format only a positively identified blank new volume under recorded authorization. Never infer blankness from a missing mount.
Preserve an existing filesystem, mount by UUID, persist fstab, set ownership and order startup after mount/network/SSM. Refuse app startup on the root disk when the data volume is missing.
Use command adapters/fixtures to test block-device operations. Deliver stack UserData/DependsOn/IAM requirements to the sole stack integrator rather than edit stack.json here.
acceptance: Blank intended disk, retained formatted disk, wrong disk, missing disk, second run and reboot cases have explicit expected outcomes; wrong/existing disk is never formatted.
Package/network failure leaves a stopped unhealthy service; no secret data in logs; region/VPC/AZ mismatch refuses before change-set creation.
Fresh-host live proof remains BLOCKED until task64; local fixture success is labeled local.

tasks.title: Implement verified uploads and bounded all-version retention
steps: Permit one backup process at a time; check staging headroom, restrictive permissions, service-private path visibility and cleanup only its own failed staging directory. Never remove an existing retained snapshot as a cleanup shortcut.

Upload manifest-verified artifacts then a completion record binding the manifest hash; download verifies completion+checksums before restore. Failed upload is not complete and emits failure/age metrics.

Replace reliance on current30+noncurrent30 expiration with total-age purge of all versions and delete markers for expired snapshot prefixes. Choose scheduled cutoff with margin so customer-deletion backups are purged within30days, e.g. eligible snapshot age29days plus hourly sweep; lifecycle is only a backstop. Own/installable hourly systemd purge service+timer; task57 wires installation and task64 proves it runs. A script without its schedule fails acceptance.

Purge dry-run lists exact stack-owned keys/versions and source timestamps; apply requires scoped prefix/age checks and recorded destructive-action authority. Fail closed on malformed timestamps, pagination errors or missing version inventory.

Keep deletion-journal records until all snapshots they protect are permanently purged; then apply separate documented minimal-metadata retention. Submit precise IAM/alarms/unit requirements to task54.
acceptance: Fixtures cover overwritten versions, delete markers, multipart remnants, pagination, incorrect prefix, clock cutoff and API denial; no eligible version silently survives a successful receipt.
Interrupted upload rejected by downloader; completed upload restores manifest-consistent contents. Failed purge yields a failed retention status, not a30day promise.
No production object deletion occurs in this task; live qualification is task66 with approved disposable resources.

tasks.title: Add bounded telemetry and prove production log redaction
steps: Implement task41 metrics interface: requests/errors/readiness, provision duration, recall/remember latency, quota/admission denial, pool occupancy, provider calls/tokens/cost, disk utilization and last verified backup age. Fixed environment/service/operation dimensions only.

Provide structured logger with recursive sensitive-field redaction and error sanitization. Capture Caddy, CLI, provider failure, mail failure, backup Git stderr and billing webhook paths; redact magic-link query strings and authorization/cookies in proxy logs.
Provide service/CLI/Caddy integration requirements to integrator; avoid independent edits to shared assembly. Use bounded buffering and flush behavior that cannot block requests indefinitely.
Specify log/metric retention, emission frequency, missing-data behavior and cost in task60 inputs. Never add tenant IDs, emails, brain IDs, facts or tokens as metric labels.
acceptance: Synthetic sentinel email/fact/token/session appears nowhere in production captured logs across success/failure paths; disabling one guard locally makes the test fail.
Development login links remain loopback-only; production cannot enable them. Telemetry failures do not cause memory data loss.
Metric JSON names/units/dimensions and sample frequencies match the frozen alarm contract; bounded buffer verified under blocked sink.

tasks.title: Integrate least-privilege infrastructure and delivered alarms
steps: Only this task edits stack.json. Apply bootstrap, backup/journal, retention and telemetry requirements as one reviewed change set; keep existing account/region, encryption, IMDSv2, inbound80/443 and SSM administration.
Add exact least-privilege versioned-object/journal/metrics/log permissions. Keep write/delete prefixes and roles separated where needed; no broad s3:* or accountwide secret read.

Wire alarm actions to an approved existing destination or explicitly priced new destination. Thresholds: readiness2 consecutive1min failures; errors>5% over5min with>=20requests; disk>=80% warning/>=90% critical; last verified backup>3h; purge failure>=1; CPU>=70% for10min; instance failure>=1. Missing health/backup/purge telemetry breaches.
Validate alarm math/units with task53, network/AZ/disk boot topology with task51, and full monthly line items with task60. Preview only; record change-set impact and no unexpected replacements.
acceptance: Template fixture checks prove every required metric has a producer, correct dimension and AlarmActions; every permission targets stack resources.
cloudformation validate-template passes. No resource creation is claimed from syntax checks.
Injected alarm delivery to the chosen destination is required in task64, not accepted from a green CloudWatch console state alone.

tasks.title: Finish onboarding, recovery UX and multi-account browser coverage
steps: Inspect and pin the current real Rakazo settings source before UI changes; match those field labels. Add authenticated selected-brain connection status with bounded polling; never treat historical account-wide discovery as proof of the selected client connection. Task65 validates these exact instructions live.

Provide actionable states for expired link, account/credential capacity, allocation pending, provider outage, deletion pending/retry, exhausted quota and restore_pending. Preserve export/delete access and zero-card Free flow.
Complete usage numbers, remaining values, reset semantics and upgrade/portal paths; billing-disabled mode never offers a paid checkout. Separate stock capacity from period quotas in wording.

Refactor browser fixture to select each login link by synthetic account, support multiple contexts, controlled provider failure, time advance and restart. Add two-account/multi-brain, rotation/back/refresh, exact usage, exhaustion, export-clone, delete/re-signup and billing fixture flows.
Keep mobile/desktop no-overflow, keyboard focus, accessible labels and clipboard checks. Submit package/CI changes to integrator; no live email or Stripe in fixture CI.
acceptance: All browser cases execute with zero skips at400px and1280px; rawtoken visible only at issuance; revoked old MCP session rejected.
Cross-account mutations do not alter victim files/usage; every mutating route rejects missing CSRF/origin; deletion retry session cannot call other routes.
Export bundle clones and matches facts; source counters match every rendered number; provider errors leak no private text; disabled billing has no checkout.

tasks.title: Prepare honest pricing, hosted instructions and reversible site activation
steps: Keep plans.v1.json generated from canonical plans; render every allowance and ratified Free/Builder/Scale prices. Do not silently change prices/caps for the pilot.
Prepare hosted guide using exact tested dashboard/Rakazo labels, empty default brain label and explicit write opt-in. Preserve the install-yourself path.
Explain selected provider processing, forget vs retained Git history, account deletion and only verified backup retention terms. No unsupported SLA, setup-time or privacy claim.

Prepare a separate, reversible activation diff for Start free/public checkout visibility; do not publish active public signup before task73. Pilot copy explicitly says invitation-only and hides unavailable paid controls without removing published ratified pricing.
acceptance: Site link checker and mobile/desktop browser tests pass; generated pricing matches server bytes.
No public call-to-action points to an unqualified or inaccessible signup path; staging preview tests links against approved origin.
Activation and rollback are named commit diffs in evidence; unavailable features are labeled, not promised as live.

tasks.title: Wire all features and gate transactional deployment and releases
steps: Integrator continuously merges approved feature wiring during predecessor tasks; now verify one assembled binary exercises every feature. Rebase each worker on merged dependencies before accepting its receipt.
Finalize config/secrets/schema contracts and CLI registrations; migration/recovery/deletion code must be invoked by real service paths, not only tests. Preserve self-hosted command behavior.

Deploy stages checksum-verified binary/config, validates secrets without output, takes a coordinated pre-upgrade snapshot, checks schema compatibility, and switches only with bounded readiness verification. Revert binary/config on compatible failure; refuse unsafe downgrade and use reviewed restore path instead. Install and enable both backup and purge timers; retain the previous manifest/config for supported rollback.

Implement three artifact states: local candidate (integration tests), restricted qualification candidate (same immutable artifact plus tasks58/59 PASS), and hosted-qualified (task70 packet). CI may build/store the first before58/59 exist; it must refuse promoting to the second/third without their exact evidence. Ordinary self-hosted releases remain possible but are not called hosted-qualified.

Create a checksum-pinned immutable unqualified Linux ARM candidate artifact in CI, with retention sufficient for qualification, source SHA and build metadata; task64 deploys this exact candidate only after58/59 pass. Teach deployment to consume a verified downloaded candidate archive, not only a published release tag. Task70 certifies these same bytes in the release packet. Task73 owns publishing the approved tag/assets without rebuilding; an optional pilot71 may keep the immutable candidate private. Record prior supported version/schema pair. No production deploy or public release tag in this task.
acceptance: Fresh and upgraded fixture service passes assembled integration suite; no unregistered/new unused feature accepted.
Bad checksum/config/secret/readiness leaves previous service usable or fails closed without data rollback; newer schema refuses older binary.
CI distinguishes fixture/live/missing-credential results and never turns a skipped live qualification into PASS; full final-head checks green.

tasks.title: Prove crash recovery with real subprocess fault injection
steps: Build a separate hostedtest-tagged CLI subprocess binary on disposable roots; use task41 private-pipe deterministic phase barriers, not sleeps. Production artifact stays untagged; no production environment switch or HTTP fault endpoint.

Kill after mkdir/before ready; canonical write/before index; flush/before accounting; first accounting phase; checkout provider success/before save; each deletion phase; partial upload; restore before publish/reactivation.
Restart and assert exact facts, counters, credentials, billing state and filesystem outcome. Exercise provider timeout and disk-full errors as well as SIGKILL.
Demonstrate a local negative control for each recovery family by disabling its repair hook in an isolated patch, record failure, then restore. Never commit the weakened version.
acceptance: Every required phase was actually reached before kill, and each expected invariant measured after restart; absent barrier is FAIL, not skip.
No acknowledged pre-crash fact lost; exactly one billed operation on retry; no account/paid-plan/token resurrection; no partial restore becomes runnable.
Fixture external services are labeled and each scenario emits a machine-readable pass/fail and negative-control result.

tasks.title: Execute the complete adversarial boundary matrix
steps: Use real HTTP/SQLite/Git with2 accounts, multiple brains and credentials. Enumerate every mutation and tool rather than sampling one route.

Cover forged/expired sessions, each POST CSRF/origin, cross-account issue/rotate/revoke/export/delete/write/read, read-only credentials, old and foreign MCP sessions, path/entity/label tricks and unsupported tools.
Cover oversized/deep JSON,4097-byte facts, cancellation, dropped responses, dashboard abuse, direct-MCP second-credential quota bypass, exhausted quotas and backup concurrency.
Assert denials preserve victim facts/counters/directories, not only status codes. Run one isolated negative control per security boundary; record review of log-redaction evidence.
acceptance: Complete route/tool inventory is covered; cross-account exposure or mutation exactly0.
Each deny result has verified unchanged victim state; tests fail under intentional local removal of the corresponding guard.
No new public debugging endpoints, auth exemptions or file-first allowlist expansion.

tasks.title: Build the cost model and bounded capacity workload
steps: Price0/10/100accounts and the original1Scale+3Builder+10Free full-limit mix. Include EC2 baseline/burst credits, root+data EBS, IPv4, KMS, secrets, hourly full snapshot amplification, S3 storage/requests, logs/metrics/alarms, transfer, email, embeddings, readiness probes and rebuilds.

Date/cite primary rates; distinguish assumptions from measurements. Compare minimum feasible AWS configuration to already-authorized existing capacity as a proposal; no automatic topology change, reservations, new GPU or spend.

Build bounded load harness with synthetic accounts, warm/cold brains, skewed tenants, retries, provider latency/failure, max facts/history and controlled synthetic billing entitlements. Never forge entitlements on public production. Freeze workload manifests before live measurement:10min warmup+30min steady+5min2x burst, total8concurrent clients, baseline4requests/s with80%recall/15%remember/5%forget,20%requests target cold brains,50%traffic one hot tenant,20–128token queries and32–512token facts. Full advertised memory/storage cardinalities for the selected profile; run quota-boundary saturation separately so expected429s cannot hide failures. Replay captures exact arrivals; repeat3times. These are reviewable qualification targets, not claims of tested performance.

Require explicit request/token/elapsed/cost caps before live mode; fixture mode cannot measure semantic quality. Report CPU/RSS/disk/writes, latency percentiles, provider totals and per-plan contribution.
Produce a conservative idle+peak monthly exposure and measurable cap recommendation. Original$60 ceiling is not a budget target or new authorization; no hidden plan-limit reductions.
acceptance: Cost math fixtures cover units and full-snapshot multiplication; all recurring categories have rates or explicit unknowns.
Harness stops at caps and cannot target a production origin without an explicit environment guard; finite run, no new worker scheduler.

Freeze with task41 reviewer before execution: CPU<70%,RSS<80%RAM,disk<80%,cold-ready<=60s,admitted recallp95<=2s/rememberp95<=3s, >=99%offered non-injected eligible steady-state requests complete, unexpected5xx<0.1%, unexpected steady admission rejection<1%, zero isolation/durability errors. Count rejections/timeouts in total outcomes, not only admitted latencies. If full-limit preparation exceeds the approved provider budget, use explicitly labeled cached/precomputed vectors for infrastructure load and a separate bounded live-provider mix; never claim a full live-provider load test ran.

tasks.title: Prepare the exact credential, budget and operator prerequisite packet
steps: Prepare named secret destinations, minimal permissions, exact config patch, selected provider terms, finite request allowance, forecast and rollback before requesting any missing external input.

OpenRouter: dedicated Serenity key at EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY, candidate model/provider pin, proposed$1 total qualification cap with no automatic reset/top-up/fallback. Confirm actual key limit and account credit status through sanitized metadata when authorized; recommendation alone is not permission.

Resend: scoped send key, sender domain records, optional separate domain-management access, controlled recipient ownership. Stripe: restricted test key for products/prices/customers/subscriptions/Checkout/portal/webhooks and generated signing secret. No live key yet.

Inventory existing AWS/foundation/notification authority read-only, and record missing permissions precisely. Prepare actual monthly deployment-cost maximum plus a separate time/cost cap and cleanup plan for rehearsal resources; do not ask user to solve implementation details.

Record mode as public-paid scope unchanged or optional invitation-only pilot explicitly selected. Existing approvals count; ask only for genuinely missing authority through the standing coordinator channel.
acceptance: Packet contains no secret values, home paths or customer data; each gate lists required evidence, responsible role and exact operation authorized.
Missing key blocks live task only; deterministic development can continue. No provider purchases, resource creation or messages are sent by preflight.
Preflight checks placeholder/permissions/config names without echoing values and distinguishes unavailable credential from failed provider validation.

tasks.title: Prepare foundation DNS changes and verify real email
steps: Discover foundation checkout from live process/map; coordinate its owner. Prepare a separate foundation PR with app A record bound to the stack EIP and exact Resend DKIM/SPF/return-path records. Do not manage the zone from Serenity scripts.
Apply through existing reviewed DNS authority after stack address exists; record foundation PR/revision. No guessed records or recipient.
With a valid scoped key, verify the sender and send a bounded test to the approved controlled mailbox. Record delivery timestamp, sender and redacted outcome, never magic-link values.

After task64 private deployment and the foundation DNS apply, verify public TLS and single-use email login at the public origin. Complete this task before task65 customer qualification; task64 does not require a public DNS/TLS success.
acceptance: DNS answers expected stack address; provider reports verified sender; controlled mailbox actually receives the link.
Public certificate valid for app origin; production link works once and expires as configured. Post-deploy evidence is folded by task65.
No real-mail PASS based solely on Resend202; provider failure remains visible and creates no false signup success claim.

tasks.title: Create isolated Stripe test products, portal and webhook configuration
steps: Confirm Sire Run account identity read-only; use testmode only. Idempotently create/reuse Serenity Builder1900USD/month and Scale4900USD/month tagged plan_version1; never alter unrelated products.

Configure portal upgrades/proration, scheduled downgrades/cancellation to match task47. Register only required events at the approved app test webhook; save generated webhook secret through secret manager, not logs.
Commands default to plan/dry-run; require explicit scoped apply and idempotency tags. Test local forwarding separately from the real public endpoint.
Finish with test object/configuration/secret setup and local forwarding fixtures only. Task67 owns all public signed delivery after tasks62/64; do not wait for64 inside this predecessor.
acceptance: Running setup twice yields same owned object IDs and no duplicates; wrong account/live credential refused.
Exact prices/events/portal settings recorded with testmode label; signing secret never appears in artifacts.
Unit fixtures pass before external apply; setup outcome cannot be described as real revenue.

tasks.title: Provision and privately deploy one cost-capped qualification environment
steps: Use reviewed exact change set/account/region, artifact SHA, selected mode and spending/rehearsal limits. Acquire R-hosted-environment; only one operator mutates the environment.

Create or use the explicitly authorized host and blank volume; bootstrap from scratch and deploy the candidate through SSM/private access. Output the EIP for task62 foundation DNS. Keep registration restricted to controlled synthetic identities. Do not require public DNS/TLS before task62.
Install working embedding/mail secrets securely, Stripe test secrets only for paid qualification profile. No live billing or public Start free activation.

Verify disk mount persistence, service identity/hardening, local Caddy forwarding, loopback readiness, initial backup+hourly timer, journal persistence and every alarm reaching its approved destination. Public certificate/DNS proof belongs to task62; private health is sufficient here. Verify the hourly purge timer is enabled and produces a receipt. Confirm deployed binary has no hostedtest fault hooks.
Capture reboot/redeploy idempotence and actual inventory/cost start time. Release operator lock and retain data safely; do not delete resources without scoped cleanup authorization.
acceptance: Private/SSM health reaches the exact artifact; configured providers work; unauthenticated private routes denied. Public exposure remains unqualified until task62.
Fresh host and reboot require no undocumented manual install/mount; missing data mount prevents start.
Injected readiness/disk/backup/purge failure produces an alert at the destination; normal status restores. All charges/resources listed against authorization.

tasks.title: Prove real embeddings and the actual Rakazo customer journey
steps: Run task43 frozen corpus with the dedicated capped key and privacy-qualified routing. Save corpus/model/provider/source hashes, ranks, exact usage and failures. Stop immediately at allowance.

Use pinned official MCP SDK through actual Caddy, then inspect/pin a real Rakazo build and settings. Verify four-tool discovery, read-only/write modes, empty label, bot/space entity scoping and two-account separation.

Save a unique synthetic fact, immediate paraphrase recall, lexical-negative control, service restart recall, stable IDs/citations, dropped-response dedup and forget absence from recall/exact read/export facts.json. Git bundle history may retain the forgotten text by design: explicitly verify/document this distinction. Verify bot/space scoping and two-account separation. No direct DB insert masquerading as customer write.
Time ten fresh controlled-mailbox browser journeys individually, from Start free/link entry to first authenticated recall. Report failures and small-sample p95; do not invent human timings.
Any changed instructions become a targeted task55/56 fix followed by relevant reruns; no broad upstream Rakazo work without a concrete reproduced defect.
acceptance: Frozen semantic thresholds pass, zero scope leakage, no forgotten result; latency/usage reported even if outside target.
Actual Rakazo works through public HTTPS after restart using dashboard-issued credential; clipboard/rawtoken rules preserved.
Ten results have complete start/end/outcome records; synthetic browser runs are explicitly not human walkthroughs.

tasks.title: Rehearse off-host restore, deletion retention, migration and rollback
steps: Use separately authorized disposable target/volume and synthetic accounts. Record snapshot, acknowledge writes, revoke token/delete account/cancel plan afterward, then restore only from actual downloaded complete backup plus independent journal.
Run plan/apply reconciliation; prove no deleted account/token/ended paid plan returns. Verify surviving memory through newly issued credential and semantic recall.

Inject corrupted bundle/DB/manifest, incomplete upload, stale journal, missing provider and interrupted apply. Measure wall time and last recoverable acknowledgment; report actual RTO/RPO, not invented SLA.

Rehearse migration from supported old schema snapshot and compatible rollback for named immutable versions. Unsupported downgrade must refuse; do not roll back production customer data to conceal migration failure.

Exercise all-version purge on explicitly disposable versioned test prefixes with an injected clock; prove the30day upper-bound policy algebra and actual API behavior. Never delete actual retained customer backups for testing.
acceptance: Off-host recovery yields expected inventory/facts and invalid old credentials; deleted accounts remain absent despite pre-deletion snapshot.
Fault cases never yield a usable partial/unsafe restore; successful migration/rollback preserves acknowledged data.
RTO/RPO and purge evidence include actual artifact hashes, journal watermark, version inventory and resource cleanup/retention disposition.

tasks.title: Execute the full Stripe lifecycle with test clocks
steps: Use dedicated synthetic test customers/clocks; drive actual Checkout/webhook/portal, not direct entitlementDB updates.
Run initial failed/incomplete purchase, activation, renewal, prorated upgrade, scheduled downgrade/cancel, fixed grace/expiry, re-subscribe, duplicate/reordered delivery and portal isolation.
Complete Checkout before webhook then delete account; race open checkout/deletion; inject provider-success/local-timeout and reconcile after restart.
Compare actual Stripe customer/subscription/invoice state with displayed plan, admission and counters. Clean only task-owned test objects; record no live charges.
acceptance: Every row in task47 state table passes against Stripe testmode; no duplicate subscription or unintended paid entitlement.
Canceled/deleted customer has no collectible surviving subscription; late events converge without permanent webhook503.
Test clock/event IDs and sanitized outcomes retained; secrets and payment/customer details absent.

tasks.title: Measure capacity and recompute the launch bill
steps: Acquire environment lock and use controlled synthetic load window. For paid profile run full1Scale+3Builder+10Free workload; pilot profile measures its explicitly approved cap without implying paid-tier qualification.
Run warm/cold/skewed/churn load and provider failure; measure actual wall time, CPU/RSS/disk, p95 latency, error/admission rates and live-provider token totals within cap.
Project idle, measured and worst-case monthly costs including backup-history amplification and readiness/recovery calls; reconcile provider receipts with internal accounting.

If targets fail, record concrete smallest correction with owner/trigger, obtain any needed architecture/plan change review, and rerun affected workload. Never silently reduce published allowances or spend past cap.
acceptance: Task60 thresholds met for selected profile or explicit FAIL prevents corresponding launch; zero durability/isolation errors.
Concrete monthly maximum is within approved budget and historical$60 ceiling; unknown line item blocks cost qualification.
Configured account/runtime caps match measured capacity, and reaching a cap fails gracefully with recovery operations available.

tasks.title: Prepare and record first-time human walkthroughs
steps: Prepare a one-page script: landing, mailbox login, token copy, Rakazo settings/write opt-in, save/paraphrase recall, export and deletion; provide approved disposable accounts and a reset procedure.

Recruit only through authorized coordinator/human channels; do not send unsolicited messages. Record up to5 consenting first-time participants, observed timings, confusion and failures without names/private memory.
Fix reproducible blocking UX problems through owning lane and rerun affected steps; preserve first-run results.

If no participants, record NOT_RUN and reason. Original scope permits explicitly unqualified human timing; only release reviewer/founder can accept that exception, and no speed claim may be published. Always produce a terminal receipt: PASS for completed observations or NOT_RUN with explicit unavailable-participants reason and coordinator-recorded exception request; never silently leave recruitment pending.
acceptance: Actual participant observations are separate from automation; no fabricated scores/timings.
All material onboarding blockers have a fix receipt or block the selected launch; accessibility/mobile checks remain passing.
Timing/public claims match evidence; unavailable participants are visible in final packet.

tasks.title: Assemble the reviewed release packet and exact launch actions
steps: Aggregate source-pinned per-task receipts for the selected pilot/paid profile. Any code change since evidence invalidates affected checks; rerun before recording PASS. Task69 must supply either actual human evidence or a documented unavailable-participants exception; this is an evidence requirement even though human availability is not a hard execution dependency.

Include immutable candidate artifact ID/archiveSHA and proposed release tag, CI, migration/rollbackpair, provider privacy/pin/budget, actual deployment inventory, secrets rotation, backup/journal/purge, alarms/recipient, measured costs/caps/RTO/RPO and security evidence.
Write copy-paste deploy/rollback/restore-plan/apply/rotate/deletion-retry runbook commands verified by a different operator. Resolve every original E23 requirement via crosswalk; no vague later.
Prepare separate reviewed pilot activation, live-billing cutover and publicsite activation diffs plus rollback. Record task69 result or explicit unqualified exception; no hidden acceptance waiver.
Ask for final action only once the packet is concrete; route through standing chief/founder surfaces. Prior valid approval is reused within scope. Plan publication is not deployment authority.

Certify the candidate as hosted-qualified in the packet only; do not publish a tag here. Task73 is the explicit release-publication owner under PUBLIC_GO; task71 may run a private pilot using the approved immutable candidate identifier.
acceptance: No required row UNKNOWN/PARTIAL/NOT_RUN for selected profile; only explicit original human-walkthrough exception may remain, acknowledged with no timing claim.
Pilot packet explicitly excludes paid readiness; paid packet includes task67. Reviewer can perform rollback from the runbook.

Candidate source/artifact/evidence match and all final checks green. Record proposed release tag; task73 performs authorized publication of the same bytes. Receipt separates implemented, merged, deployed, live and deferred with owners/triggers.

allowed_dependency_exceptions.T23.69: NOT_RUN only with dated coordinator/human-unavailable disposition; no timing claims; release reviewer acknowledges exception

tasks.title: Activate an optional invitation-only Free pilot
steps: Only after explicit selection/approval of the pilot packet, apply the exact allowlist/accountcap and billing_disabled configuration; use existing approved resources and budget.
Provide approved testers the actual signup/client journey through authorized human channels. Recheck readiness, isolation, write/recall, verified backup and alarm delivery.
Do not activate public Start free/paid Checkout or imply all paid launch requirements passed. Preserve proposed paid tasks in the ledger with trigger: pilot exit and paid packet approval.
On smoke failure close new registrations and roll back compatible config/binary without deleting memories.
acceptance: Uninvited direct signup refused; invited new person uses real email+Rakazo without operator setup; billing disabled.
Pilot cohort/limit/budget and operator owner recorded; exact version matches approved packet.
Go/no-go is dated and traceable to human authority, not inferred from greenCI.

tasks.title: Activate live Stripe with a bounded operator payment
steps: Prepare exact live products/prices/webhook/portal diff from tested configuration, confirm Sire Run account and obtain dedicated restricted live credential securely. Never reuse test webhook secret.
Apply only after paid packet and specific live-charge authorization (amount, customer/operator, refund handling) are recorded. Perform one bounded operator Checkout and confirm signed entitlement.

Exercise rollback disabling new checkout and restoring test/config mode without pretending it cancels existing live subscriptions. Reconcile/refund/cancel operator subscription explicitly as authorized.
Record payment as operator smoke, not customer revenue; keep public signup/site activation closed until task73.
acceptance: Correct liveprice/customer/webhook yields one intended charge and entitlement; no unrelated objects touched.
Observed charge/refund/subscription disposition and config rollback verified; secrets absent from receipts.
Failure blocks paid launch and returns checkout to safe disabled state without losing memory.

tasks.title: Perform the public launch go/no-go and final customer smoke
steps: Present final paid release packet and explicit state/cost/remaining-risk summary to David through the standing path; obtain go/no-go, not silence-as-consent.

On go, publish the reviewed release tag/assets from the exact qualified immutable candidate without rebuilding, then apply reviewed public registration/site activation diff. Verify source/tag/archiveSHA, DNS/TLS/email and Free signup→Rakazo write→recall→export/delete; published prices/limits and paid path match qualified objects.
On no-go/failure, preserve private candidate and data, disable new admission/Checkout and execute reviewed compatible rollback. No unsupported public availability or SLA announcement.
Record exact release/deploy/site/Stripe revisions, time and operator; start the finite observation window in task74.
acceptance: New customer can complete the journey without server setup; Free requires no card; public pages reflect actual behavior.
All required paid gates passed on deployed revision; no code/secret/config drift since qualification.
Dated human go/no-go and final smoke receipts are attached; launched is never inferred from merged.

tasks.title: Observe the launch and close the epic with owned follow-ups
steps: After selected launch predecessor, observe24h using existing CloudWatch/systemd/budget mechanisms. Do not build a polling daemon or hold an interactive agent sleeping overnight.
Check actual signup/error/admission rates, privacy-safe provider spend, backup completion/age, journal/purge state, disk/CPU and alert delivery. Compare costs to approved forecast.
At24h issue a finite operator receipt. Any critical isolation/durability/billing failure closes new signup/checkout and invokes runbook; retain customer data.

Close selected milestone only with named support/operator owner, next restore/rotation rehearsal date, and every deferred item carrying taskID/owner/dependency/trigger. Paid tasks remain open after a pilot.
acceptance: Observation has a start/end and actual metrics; missing telemetry or backup is a failure, not quiet success.
No spend over approved cap; remaining issues are actionable assigned rows.
Pilot-complete and paid-launch-complete are reported distinctly with exact artifact and launch authorization.
